checks: complete bounded JSON syntax; explicit stack depth<=64; paired surrogate handling
all decoded object keys unique before dictionary materialization
kind PACK_V3, format3, rules3 in header order; widths/types
all required ordered record/enum fields, no unknowns, all scalar grammars/widths/metadata bounds
eight collection caps, amount4, prerequisite64, strict sorted unique keys
complete canonical bytes equality, literalUnicode/no normalization
valid positive pack_version, fraction prerequisite/nonamplification, actual listed ResourceAmount quantities
all resource/technology references resolve; iterative acyclic prerequisite graph
expected exact PACK hash only in optional external consumer-check context
Catalog has no self-integrity field; compute PACK(domainNUL || complete canonical Catalog)
